The Question

Hungry in Charlotte and Still Deciding?

You are uptown, you are hungry, and every option sounds the same. Then you catch it: warm spices, meat roasting, garlic sauce in the air, coming from North Caldwell Street.

So why settle for a boring lunch when the spit is already turning?

The Reveal

The Lineup Everybody Orders

This is the actual menu, ranked by the people who eat here. No filler, just the plates and wraps that built the name.

No. 1 Most Liked

Chicken Shawarma Plate

Sliced grilled chicken thighs with special Mediterranean herbs and spices, served over yellow aromatic rice with a side of your choice and two sauces, Garlic and the Famous Sauce.

No. 2 Most Liked

Gyro Wrap

Beef and lamb gyro meat with tzatziki sauce, lettuce, onions and tomatoes, roasted on the grill. Your pick of bread, pita or tortilla broiled bread.

No. 3 Most Liked

Chicken Shawarma Wrap

Chicken shawarma with garlic sauce, lettuce, pickles and Famous sauce, roasted on the grill and served with a side of garlic sauce.

The Heavy Hitter

Beef Shawarma Plate

Sliced grilled beef with special herbs and spices over yellow aromatic rice, with a side of your choice and both sauces, Garlic and Famous.

Best of Both

Mixed Shawarma Plate

Chicken and beef shawarma together on one plate over rice, for everybody who refuses to choose. Because why choose?

The Fresh One

Falafel Wrap and Plate

Six pieces of falafel covered with sumac and parsley, wrapped up or plated over rice. Crispy outside, bright and herby inside.

Hummus, baba ganouj, grape leaves and warm pita, ready for scooping

And that is not all: chicken kabab plates and wraps, shawarma fries, kibbeh, hummus and baba ganouj with pita, grape leaves, a cheeseburger, and Dubai baklava to close it out. Call and ask what is fresh today.

The Connect

This Is Shawarma 2 Go

Armenian, Lebanese and Mediterranean flavor, cooked fast and made to move. One spot, one spit, right in the middle of Charlotte.
